image_description: A close-up shot of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near coral. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. The background is a blurred blue aquatic environment with rocky textures.
